title: DevHarness Planning Draft Output
description: Producer output contract for the DevHarness planning draft that proposes implementation and review routes.

outcome.description: Producer must use ready_for_attack for an initial or critic-requested plan, ready_for_approval for a correction requested at the user gate, and blocked only for a recoverable pause.
outcome.x-usage: Treat this as the authoritative workflow state for this output. Do not infer success from other populated fields when this says blocked or needs revision.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the implementation plan proposal state for human approval without embedding the implementation-plan artifact body.
summary.x-usage: Use this as the human-facing approval state for the implementation plan gate. Show it with the artifact attachment; do not recreate the summary from artifact contents in the orchestrator.

selected_implementation_steps.description: Producer must select the concrete implementation branch step ids required by this plan.
selected_implementation_steps.x-usage: Use this approved list as the exact implementation fan-out target. Do not add branches unless the plan is revised and approved.

selected_review_steps.description: Producer must select only concrete review branch step ids that must actually run for this plan.
selected_review_steps.x-usage: Use this approved list as the exact initial fan-out target. Do not include optional, informational, or absence-confirmation reviewers here; record them in skipped_review_steps instead.

step_id.description: Producer must name the reviewer step that was considered but not selected for fan-out.
step_id.x-usage: Use this only as skipped-planning evidence. Do not run this branch unless a later fanout owner selection explicitly selects it.

reason.description: Producer must state the evidence-backed reason this reviewer should not run for this slice.
reason.x-usage: Use this to audit reviewer pruning. Do not treat the reason text as permission to run the reviewer.

surfaces.description: Producer may list surfaces checked only to justify not selecting this reviewer.
surfaces.x-usage: Use these as checked-but-not-routed surfaces. They do not expand review scope by themselves.

skipped_review_steps.description: Producer may record reviewers considered but intentionally not selected for runtime fan-out.
skipped_review_steps.x-usage: Use this only as non-routing planning evidence. Do not run these reviewer branches unless the approved plan or review owner selection selects them.

reason.description: Producer must explain why more than three reviewers must run.
reason.x-usage: Treat weak or generic rationale as a planning error; expanded fan-out needs specific material risk.

risk_classes.description: Producer must list the independent material risk classes requiring expanded review fan-out.
risk_classes.x-usage: Use this to verify that each extra reviewer maps to a distinct material risk class.

review_escalation.description: Producer must populate this only when selected_review_steps contains more than three reviewers.
review_escalation.x-usage: Treat missing or weak escalation as a planning contract error; do not expand review fan-out merely because reviewer roles exist.

step_id.description: Producer must set the workflow step id for this reviewer or branch entry.
step_id.x-usage: Match this against selected_review_steps. Treat a mismatch as a contract error, not an optional suggestion.

reason.description: Producer must state why this reviewer or workflow step is needed for the scoped work.
reason.x-usage: Use this to understand why this step or role was selected. Do not expand the assigned scope beyond the listed surfaces.

surfaces.description: Producer must list the code, contract, docs, data, or UX surfaces this reviewer must inspect.
surfaces.x-usage: Use these as the exact focus surfaces for the assigned work. Do not assume unlisted surfaces are covered.

required.description: Producer must mark whether this reviewer is mandatory for completion.
required.x-usage: Selected reviewers are mandatory by definition. Optional reviewers must be represented in skipped_review_steps, not review_plan.reviewers or selected_review_steps.

reviewers.description: Producer must include one mandatory reviewer entry per selected review step, with reason and inspected surfaces.
reviewers.x-usage: Match entries against selected_review_steps and use them for coverage. Do not run unlisted or skipped agents unless the plan is revised or blocked escalation requires it.

review_plan.description: Producer must draft the review contract describing selected mandatory reviewers, reasons, and surfaces.
review_plan.x-usage: Treat this as the proposed review contract until plan approval. After approval, use it as the scope for selected review steps.

artifacts.description: Producer must emit artifact metadata for the required immutable implementation-plan artifact when ready for attack or approval.
artifacts.x-usage: Emit only the required implementation-plan artifact. The full readable plan/proposal body lives in the referenced artifact file; structured routing fields remain in JSON.

results.description: Producer may emit compact structured results, decisions, or evidence summaries created by this stage.
results.x-usage: Use these as supporting evidence or compact summaries. Do not let them override outcome, selected steps, blockers, or approved contracts.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the relevant decision or handoff in concise human-readable form without adding new scope.
summary.x-usage: Use this as concise human-readable context only. Do not route, approve, or expand scope from this text.

source_step_id.description: Producer must name the workflow step id that found or owns this blocker or finding.
source_step_id.x-usage: Use this to identify the step that found or owns the blocker/finding. Do not treat it as a retry target by itself.

needed.description: Producer must state the exact missing decision, permission, input, or evidence required to proceed.
needed.x-usage: Surface this exact missing input, permission, evidence, or decision before proceeding. Do not substitute assumptions for it.

evidence.description: Producer should list concrete evidence references supporting this handoff, verdict, finding, or blocker.
evidence.x-usage: Use these references to inspect or challenge the claim. Do not assume unreferenced surfaces were checked.

risk.description: Producer should describe the residual risk if this blocker or finding is ignored.
risk.x-usage: Use this to understand why ignoring the item is unsafe. Treat it as risk context unless paired with a blocked outcome.

blocker.description: Producer must populate this when outcome is blocked, naming the recoverable pause reason, owning step, and specific missing input or permission.
blocker.x-usage: Treat this as a recoverable pause. Surface the missing input or decision, then continue this same workflow step after it is resolved.
